technical.summary: Short-term momentum (RSI-9) is extremely overbought with conflicting intermediate signals; price is below key moving averages and Ichimoku cloud, creating pullback risk despite some bullish structure indicators.

fundamental.summary: WELL shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 42 days creating elevated event risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (16/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity; weak congressional buying from junior member provides minimal conviction support; no recent news data to confirm setup.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (364.48), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising dollar pressuring multinationals, with earnings event in 42 days adding execution risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI-9 extreme overbought with Hull flip up and Supertrend bullish suggests short-term momentum reversal potential, supported by extreme fear sentiment (16/100) offering contrarian opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below EMA-21, EMA-50, and Ichimoku cloud with negative CMF and OBV; RSI-14 at 33.82 shows intermediate weakness; macro environment in crisis (VIX 364.48) with earnings risk in 42 days and zero fundamental conviction.

decision.entry_rationale: RSI-9 extreme overbought with Hull flip and Supertrend bullish offer short-term momentum potential in fear-zone sentiment (16/100). However, price trapped below all key moving averages and Ichimoku cloud with negative CMF/OBV creates high pullback risk that outweighs entry quality.
